name: Shear-Warp Algorithm
definition: A hybrid image-order and object-order algorithm that facilitates interpolation by decomposing the viewing transformation into a 3D shear, a projection, and a 2D warp to substitute trilinear interpolation with bilinear interpolation.
summary: The Shear-Warp Algorithm is a fast software volume rendering technique that factorizes viewing transformations into shear and warp steps to optimize memory access and interpolation.
